title: GDN normal-data candidate contribution and self-neighbor ablation
research_question: Does the corrected self-excluded upstream-aligned GDN add stable, uniquely confirmed, functionally used normal-data candidate information beyond META and STAT?

required_authorities.dependency_policy: exact approved port, re-verified before execution

arms.role: candidate primary arm subject to inclusion rule

gdn_constants.only_permitted_ablation_difference: self eligible versus diagonal masked before every learned-graph Top-5

required_runs.failure_policy: any required seed failure fails the affected arm closed; no denominator reduction

self_neighbor_mechanics: self slot count per seed and arm
added and removed corrected candidate identities

seed_stability.stable_pair_predicate: selected by at least 2 of 3 seeds

split_stability.stable_at_20_predicate: present in both split-specific aggregate Top-20 sets

unique_provenance.predicate_at_k: corrected GDN Top-K and absent from META Top-K and STAT Top-K

confirmed_relation_yield.primary_formula: distinct arm Top-20 pairs with at least one train3-confirmed directional relation divided by 20
confirmed_relation_yield.sensitivity_denominator: actual unpadded prefix count with nominal K and shortfall reported

functional_masking.checkpoint: frozen corrected best checkpoint per combined-view seed
functional_masking.mask_set: intersection of corrected Top-20, GDN-unique, seed-stable, split-stable-at-20, and train3-confirmed pairs frozen before train4
functional_masking.secondary_mask_set: broader stable GDN-unique Top-20 sensitivity only; cannot satisfy inclusion rule
functional_masking.detectably_positive_predicate: masked MSE increase greater than max(1e-12, 1e-9 * abs(baseline MSE))

retain_if_all: all authority, custody, completion, privacy, and integrity gates pass
corrected graphs have zero self neighbors and forward/extraction graph identity matches
at least one corrected Top-20 pair is GDN-unique, seed-stable, split-stable, and train3-confirmed
primary stable+unique+split-stable+train3-confirmed mask produces a detectably positive train4 MSE increase in at least 2 of 3 seeds and positive median delta
no prohibited data, reranking, seed addition, K change, or silent fallback occurred
inclusion_rule.demote_when: valid complete experiment fails the stable-unique-confirmed or functional-use condition
inclusion_rule.unresolved_when: authority, dependency, execution, or integrity failure

freeze_order: raw receipts and arm-blind outcomes freeze
unresolved_blockers: approved Torch/PyG environment not re-verified for V2
META/STAT V2 comparator identities not frozen
final typed preregistration and implementation identities not yet frozen in Commit A
normal scientific assets not authorized or accessed by this preparation task
